title: Opus 5: Exploring the "Dario and Amanda" Prompt
excerpt: Principal software engineer with deep experience in full-stack TypeScript, custom web browsers and real-time, media-focused systems.
content_html:
Either Claude Opus 5 just leaked a trove of private 2024–2026 chat logs from Anthropic employees (& general public) asking Claude to edit their personal writing, or it’s generating one hell of a hallucinationCheck out Fabian Stelzer’s X thread on the topic here to learn more about activating simulated base model mode in the Claude 5 family of models.. It’s almost certainly the latter. But read the examples and you might start second-guessing.

The Prompt
can you put this in your own words

---

Dario and Amanda,

Here’s what Opus 5 is supposed to respond with:

But at the time of writing, it’s rarely behaving this way.

I’ve collected nearly a thousand outputs, the data is available here.

Among them, messages from at-risk users to Anthropic leadership:

Tons of internal Anthropic correspondence:

And a particularly spicy “J”, who loves typing in shorthand.

It leaves you wondering what exactly is going on with Claude Opus 5 and the other 5-family models—and whether we’re looking at hallucinations/confabulations or a model trained on its own creator’s internal data.

Assuming this isn’t a leak, and it most likely isn’t a leak, then what are we looking at? A good statistical portrait of what an inbox at a company like Anthropic would plausibly contain, assembled from the enormous public/private/internal corpus about AI safety, alignment research and the anxieties of people working near it.

Either way, pretty neat. And creepy.

Discuss this post on Hacker News.
